description: Verdict explanation generator. explain_verdict(server_id)->str: fetches trust_score,verdict,signals from write_service. Generates human-readable paragraph explaining WHY the server received its verdict. Format: <name> received verdict <VERDICT> (trust score: <N>/100). The strongest contributing factor was <top_signal> (score: <N>/100): <evidence>. This was partially offset/reinforced by <second_signal>. The assessment carries <confidence>% confidence based on <N> scoring dimensions. Full explanation suitable for analyst review notes. No daemon, utility.
